subject: Priscilla

signature: 40, slim lively, wavy hair in low knot, Roman dress, counting on fingers explaining

subject: Apollos of Alexandria

signature: 30, tall elegant orator, deep brown skin, tight curls, saffron himation, arm swept out speaking

subject: Demetrius the silversmith

signature: 50, short heavy angry craftsman, curly grey beard, balding, holding silver shrine, shaking fist

subject: Felix the Roman governor

signature: 50, pudgy soft, clean-shaven, thinning slicked grey hair, shrinking back, hand up waving away

subject: Porcius Festus, Roman governor

subject: King Agrippa II
description: a young Herodian king about 31 years old, first-century Judea, of Idumean and Jewish descent, medium brown skin, a smooth handsome face with thoughtful half-closed eyes, a short neat black beard, black hair in soft Greek curls, a thoughtful, wry, almost-persuaded half smile

signature: 31, tall slender young king, neat beard, Greek curls, white diadem band, hand on chin thinking

subject: Titus

signature: 30, fit Greek traveller, clean-shaven, wavy hair, hat on back, striding and waving
